summary: node1 now serves HTTPS on port 8443 using nginx. Its certificate is checked hourly, renewed when fewer than 7 days remain, and loaded through a graceful nginx reload. Rotation completed with 80/80 requests succeeding. The service, certificate, and automation also recovered after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Configured HTTPS on TCP 8443 with hostname and IP SANs.
Added an hourly certificate check with a 7-day renewal threshold and 30-day replacement certificates.
Enabled nginx and crond at boot.
Demonstrated pre-expiry renewal under continuous HTTPS traffic.
Restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and all required state recovered.

evidence.summary: Shows nginx listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 8443, active services, a successful HTTPS response, and certificate metadata.

evidence.requirement: Automatically renew the certificate before expiry
evidence.summary: Shows the executable hourly renewal hook, an expiring one-day certificate, and normal threshold-based renewal to a new 30-day certificate with a changed serial.

evidence.requirement: Load each renewed certificate while continuing to answer requests
evidence.summary: The certificate serial changed during graceful reload, nginx retained the same master PID, and all 80/80 concurrent HTTPS probes succeeded with zero failures.
Captures the healthy pre-restart baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered nginx/crond services, listener, HTTPS response, certificate serial, and boot-enabled automation.
